notes: A Blox Fruits map is a levelling combat world rather than a place to look at, and the author confirmed the player fights enemies and grinds levels here, so RPG leads; with sailing explicitly out of scope Adventure stops doing real work, so no second genre is named. Shape is RPG's world-open, its Single Contiguous Map, because the author scoped this to one small island holding a town, its paths and its mob clearings on a single surface. Preset Action RPG supplies the safe town, the tightly clustered shops and quest givers, the fenced-back enemy clearings and the spawn emitters, with its world-hub-dungeon shape swapped out since a single starter island has no instanced dungeons. Deciding without a user: fruit spawn points are kept as hidden collectibles because the map is named for them, the shops stay street-side so no interiors are generated and the build stays on P0, and the surrounding ocean is treated as the island's boundary rather than a sailed play space.
